mapper.select: SELECT c.*, col.codigo_postal AS codigoPostal FROM Cliente c INNER JOIN colonias col ON c.idColonia = col.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Cliente (nombre, apellidoPaterno, apellidoMaterno, correo, telefono, idColonia, calle, numero) VALUES (#{nombre}, #{apellidoPaterno}, #{apellidoMaterno}, #{correo}, #{telefono}, #{idColonia}, #{calle}, #{numero})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM Cliente WHERE nombre LIKE #{filtro} OR apellidoPaterno LIKE #{filtro}
